rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for ill will or a deliberate wish to annoy or thwart someone.

example.english: They deliberately put wrong information in my report out of spite.
example.traditional: 佢特登喺我份報告度寫錯資料，擺明係有惡意。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dak6 dang1 hai2 ngo5 fan6 bou3 gou3 dou6 se2 co3 zi1 liu2 baai2 ming4 hai6 jau5 ok3 ji3

rows.note: Use this when the spite is expressed as an openly hostile attitude toward someone.

example.english: The two teams showed open hostility and spite from the moment they came out.
example.traditional: 兩隊球員一出場就互相挑釁，場面充滿敵意。
example.jyutping: loeng5 deoi6 kau4 jyun4 jat1 ceot1 coeng4 zau6 wu6 soeng1 tiu1 jan6 coeng4 min2 cung1 mun5 dik6 ji3

rows.note: Use this when the spite centres on resentment or hatred built up against someone.

example.english: They have carried years of resentment and spite toward their former boss.
example.traditional: 佢對住前老闆積咗好多年怨恨，至今仲放唔低。
example.jyutping: keoi5 deoi3 zyu6 cin4 lou5 baan2 zik1 zo2 hou2 do1 nin4 jyun3 han6 zi3 gam1 zung6 fong3 m4 dai1
